observed_chain: Actual fixed registration is WATER_AMBIENT with IN_WATER placement and own water/SPAWNER predicate, separate config roll and random finalize phenotype. Habitat/breed resources declare nested am_spawns and seagrass; only direct SAND predicate and resource bytes are proved, not loaded tag/biome availability, natural cap opportunities or installed runtime.

Native BreedGoal seeks same-class compatible loving mate, bounds continuation by partner alive/love and loveTime<60, and invokes overridden breed at adjusted-delay/distance gate. Terrapin captures mate phenotype to ordinary partnerData memory, sets HasEgg only on carrier, resets both love and ages both6000; stats/advancement/XP requests occur without creating offspring. Goal scheduling/actual mating delivery remain unverified.

Payload is a six-field phenotype snapshot, not UUID genealogy/owner. Partner is sampled at mating; carrier is sampled later at laying, so no same-instant pair snapshot is guaranteed. Own NBT and TerrapinData preserve HasEgg and own phenotype but do not encode or clear partnerData. Freshly reconstructed pregnant carrier has null partnerData and may use itself for both BE parents; load on an already-existing object does not itself prove null/cleared mate data.

Food-tag interaction first requests persistence. Bucketable pickup optional is evaluated before the eagerly evaluated super.mobInteract argument; parent reads then-current hand. Native pickup saves tag, creates filled result/sets hand then discards; this is source ordering only. Parent Animal food route consumes unless instabuild and marks love600 under stated server/age/love gate. No duplicate-consumption gameplay is inferred.

HasEgg participates in shouldLeaveWater. Leave-water generateTarget examines at most8 nonnull candidate positions but may make9 LandRandomPos.getPos calls: initial call plus a replacement after every water-rejected candidate, including the last unexamined replacement. Helper internal attempts/navigation/collision/scheduling are not read or observed; no arrival guarantee.

LayEgg inherits native bounded target search/restriction/distance bookkeeping, requires empty block above suitable habitat, and implements no dig wait despite digTime field. At reached dry target, event/audio precede setBlock; nextInt(1)+3 requests exactly3 eggs. Return is ignored; obtainable egg BE gets direct parent1=current carrier, parent2=remembered mate or parent1. No explicit setChanged follows these assignments. On normal return HasEgg clears and love becomes600 regardless of placement/BE success. A prior chunk-unsaved flag may still save fields; lack of explicit dirty is not proof all saves lose them.

Incubation is randomTick gated by habitat and timeOfDay strictly(0.65,0.69) or world.random1/15, advancing HATCH up to2. Hatch calls removeBlock first and ignores its boolean, then loops original EGGS: create has no null guard, age-24000, optional post-removal BE phenotype, FromBucket=true, per-index position then unchecked add. No finalizeSpawn or checkSpawnRules in hatch sink. Exceptions/reentrancy may interrupt order; no exact admitted count or guaranteed removal.

For old EGGS>1, egg onRemove skips super. Actual Forge server LevelChunk setBlockState invokes old onRemove and has no second unconditional BE removal for a non-BE replacement; client branch differs. getBlockEntity returns existing unremoved BE without validating current block, so normal server post-remove lookup can retain parent data. For EGGS<=1 default onRemove forwards removal, but LevelChunk removal itself is loaded/client conditional; external/reentrant removal or state replacement can change outcome. Neither all parent data lost nor always durable is proved; failed remove may also leave BE.

Offspring inheritance requires both parent fields nonnull. Type/shell/skin independently select one parent; packed integer colors are averaged rather than per RGB channel. Conditional mutation forces OVERLAY and nextInt(2) can execute only cases0/1, never skin case2. Enum colors and children are parts of one payload algorithm. ParentData.canMerge is defined but no call occurs in complete reviewed entity/egg/BE/AMBlockItem placement chain; no repository-wide absence claim.

Stacking increments one EGGS block-state count while retaining a single two-parent BE payload, no per-egg parent list. Ordinary AMBlockItem has no Terrapin placement override. After successful native placement and same-block recheck, permission-gated BlockItem merges incoming BlockEntityTag into saveWithoutMetadata then load/setChanged only if different; return is not inspected by placement. Incoming nonempty compound fields can update the shared parents used by the whole stack. There is no shown canMerge compatibility gate.

Supplementary native CompoundTag merge is recursive. An empty incoming parent compound preserves existing nested keys when merged into an existing compound, instead of necessarily zeroing prior parent data. In a fresh BE with no previous parent compound, present empty parent tag loads ParentData whose missing integer fields resolve0 (type GREEN at ordinal0). TileEntityTerrapinEgg.load leaves an absent parent field unchanged on an existing object. These are distinct fresh/existing/missing/empty conditions, not a guaranteed observed mixed-stack outcome.

Silk getDrops returns one new egg-item stack per invocation independently of EGGS; it exports both parent compounds if either exists, with absent parent represented as an empty compound. Both parents absent still leaves an empty BlockEntityTag but writes neither parent. This does not prove a whole stack loses eggs: playerDestroy separately calls removeOneEgg and native actual break/drop callback ordering was not expanded. Non-silk override returns empty list. No inventory pickup, crafting/payment or drop success acceptance.

ItemModFishBucket checkExtraContent requests spawn then ENTITY_PLACE event. EntityType.spawn finalizes/configures new mob (including custom EntityTag path) before void addFreshEntityWithPassengers and returns entity independent of per-add result. Only after that does mod bucket restore TerrapinData and force FromBucket=true. Thus post-add-attempt pregnancy/phenotype restoration is real order; nonnull result/event does not prove admission, success-complete state seen by every hook, or exactly-once delivery.

Native ServerLevel add result can befalse for removed entity or failed entityManager add, and onAddedToWorld runs only on true. Hatch ignores bool; bucket wrapper discards bool via void passenger dispatcher. FromBucket custom persistence skips the shown outer nonpersistent despawn event/distance branch; earlier conditional peaceful logic and other removal/save causes are not universal protections. No entityManager/event internals, native cap fixes, loaded-save or postspawn survival acceptance.
